opportunity: foldcallret (default-on) moves a single-use call's evaluation to where its result is printed. Its order-safety predicate stated the barrier set in opcodes (CALL/LOAD/STORE/CALLOTHER), but heritage promotes a write to a fixed address into a plain CPUI_COPY, so a call sank past a write to a global it reads and the emitted C computed a different value than the binary.
test_name: tests/stages/kuna-foldcallret-barrier.xml (single pass, defaults: target = the issue verbatim, target2 = the write after the use so the expression travels to the return) + tests/cli/foldcallret-sinks-call-past.json
binary: decompiler/crates/kuna-analysis/tests/fixtures/gh657_x86_64 (hand-assembled, 5000 bytes) and a synthetic bytechunk of the same bytes in the stage test
change_kind: strict correctness fix, no option: it only removes folds that reorder a call past a write it may observe. `--option foldcallret off` is still the whole pass's escape hatch.
inspiration: PR #654 (foldcallretphi), which had already written the tied-storage barrier and the print-point walk for the opt-in fold; this shares them rather than copying them.
root_cause: op_is_barrier tested opcodes only, and call_output_foldable's span ended at the single use. A write to a global is a CPUI_COPY whose output varnode is persistent and address-tied, and when the use op's own output is implied the expression is printed further on, so the call crossed writes on both counts.

fix.clause_1: op_is_barrier also stops at an op whose output varnode is_persist() || is_addr_tied() (op_writes_tied_storage, moved out of kuna_foldcallretphi.rs into kuna_callretfold.rs and shared).
fix.clause_2: check_implied_cover re-asks for a call output: fold_print_point_is_order_safe runs the barrier test over the span from the call to the statement the expression lands in (print_chain follows the implied chain; ActionMarkImplied classifies descendants first, so it is derivable there).
fix.exemption_self_copy: op_is_self_copy: a CPUI_COPY back into the storage its input already occupies (what RuleIndirectCollapse leaves behind) writes the value already there. Volatile excluded. Without it gh275-spillargtrial #3 and LIBCTYPES #9 each lose a fold to an artifact.
fix.exemption_chain: the ops the expression travels through are exempt from the span test: each consumes the previous one's value, so the call is evaluated before them in the folded text exactly as in the binary. Without it the guard declines 233 further functions on the sweep (290 changed instead of 57) and ghidra_sim_faillog_pins' flattened-C line counts move (+4 sub_2620, +5 sub_3ad0).
fix.not_widened: the INDIRECT test keeps the call-to-use span for the DEFAULT fold. Asking it past the use changes 31 functions across grep O0, tar O0 and ssh O2 and de-folds 27 of them, correcting none; the dominant shape is `dat_33798 = *__errno_location()` (grep O0 sub_6c53), whose binary is call/mov/mov in exactly that order. Exempting the self-copy from it as well makes kuna-elfmain's sub_1357(a1[1]) fold where it did not before -- a NEW fold, which this fix has no business adding.
fix.phi_span_restored: the span PAST the use is foldcallretphi's, and the first version of this PR narrowed its INDIRECT test to the landing statement alone, which WIDENED the option: with `--option foldcallretphi on` it folded two calls it used to decline (ssh O2 sub_4fd30 printed sub_3fa80 after `v5 = v2`, a copy of the escaped stack slot the binary reloads at 0x4fe98 -- GH-181's shape; tar O0 sub_67494 folded three tolower calls into a store whose base the call INDIRECTs) and recovered none. landing_span_reads_call_effect asks the question over the whole span again, landing statement included, as #654 did. It is reachable only from conflict_is_self_call_effect, so default output is unaffected.

witnesses.repro.c: the issue verbatim; gcc -O2; binary returns 50, pre-fix C reads 91. Fixed by clause 1.
witnesses.repro.c + `int u = t * 3;`: same, because gcc schedules the global store before the arithmetic. Fixed by clause 1.
witnesses.travel.s: hand-written asm where the write lands between the use and the return; needs clause 2 (clause-1-only build still folds it).
witnesses.libselinux.so.1 sub_16170: real binary: strdup at 0x162d0, the two stack writes at 0x162d5/0x162dd. Pre-fix kuna emits `v23 = 1; v22 = 0x6666666; *(char **)(a0 + 0x50) = strdup(v12);`, now `v9 = strdup(v14);` first.

The default GH-657 fix de-folds `sub_11e30(2)` in this function, which re-dirties neighbouring covers, so inflate_test now reaches a rejection the discount forgives and `v5 = (char *)sub_102c0(dat_21a98), *v5` prints as `*(char *)sub_102c0(dat_21a98)`.
